svg.title: The Daily Nexus generation pipeline
svg.desc: Four phases run left to right. Collect reads the approved Gmail label and allowed public pages. Editorial extracts stories, drafts the host script and fact-checks it. The run then splits into two independent tracks: a Read edition rendered with ReportLab and PyMuPDF, and a Listen track spoken locally by Kokoro and assembled with FFmpeg. Both rejoin at Deliver, which stages the episode in the local archive and optionally publishes a private Firebase feed. A separate optional band shows the same eight stages running unattended after a Cloudflare clock wakes a private GitHub Actions runner.
